mostWorthwhile.text: Strengthening one synapse was most worthwhile: the planned comparison separates a larger local response from a larger travelling impulse and shows that a neighbouring connection need not change.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding astrocytes was less informative than expected: the resulting picture places them among the circuits but does not show the potassium and transmitter uptake described on the initial board.

surprise.text: The final example clarified that increased receptor availability can strengthen a local response without changing the height of travelling impulses.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, although attaching ready-made dendrites and axons was a simplified construction rather than an explanation of how those processes grow.

continue.text: Yes. I would continue to see how these cellular constructions connect to larger systems; the contrasting voltage traces and localized synaptic change made the circuit meaningful, even though the assembly sequence was fairly predictable.
